text:
oliver: heads-up - seeing leader election jitter in eu-west1 apiserver cluster since ~02:15 UTC. nodes flip leader every ~20s. GPU attach jobs stall. cc @marta @jia

marta: ack. what's the immediate impact? Are GPU pod AttachVolume failing?

oliver: AttachVolume timeouts up to 90s, controller-manager logs show lease renew errors. Autoscaler holds allocation for pending pods. Example errors in logs below.

jia: pasting excerpts from controller-manager and apiserver logs

```
I0310 02:15:12.345 controller_leader.go:87] failed to renew lease: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = "transport: connection lost"
E0310 02:15:32.789 apiserver.go:456] etcd request timed out (etcdserver: leader changed)
```

kevin: looks like NAT punch / SNAT exhaustion earlier — saw SNAT util spike in the NAT metric dash. conntrack hits 65535 on the gateway.

Suggestion: bump apiserver keepalive and reduce client-side dialer reuses? Also open a small SNAT quota for eu-west1 temporarily.

oliver: @kevin can you confirm which NAT nodes? I saw a flurry from 10.50.0.0/16

kevin: nat-gw-3 and nat-gw-4. I've started removing some stale conntrack entries: `sudo conntrack -D -s 10.50.0.0/16` on nat-gw-4. Monitoring.

sre-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-0323 - controlplane-leader-jitter-euwest - Sev2

marta: for mitigation let's try: 1) Drain and reboot nat-gw-4, 2) Restart apiserver on a single node to re-elect cleanly, 3) Temporarily disable aggressive attach retries on provisioner.

jia: metrics snapshot:

```
apiserver_leader_changes_total{region="eu-west1"} 42
apiserver_client_conn_dropped{node="apiserver-07"} 128
nat_snat_ports_used{gw="nat-gw-4"} 65534
```

oliver: rolling restart of apiserver-07 in progress: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/apiserver --grace-period=0`

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by oliver: /rollout apiserver patch - safe roll

kevin: reboot of nat-gw-4 scheduled, ETA ~6m. also raising SNAT pool in case needed.

marta: adding a temporary policy to route controlplane egress via nat-gw-2 while we reboot gw-4. will revert after stabilization.

jia: after conntrack cleanup apiserver leader flips dropped to 1 in the last 2m. AttachVolume latency down to ~12s. :thumbsup:

oliver: thanks team. follow-up action items: file an ops runbook for NAT port saturation and consider adding automatic SNAT scaling. I'll update the incident.
